en.headline: Tsuen Wan construction site water main burst sends jet tens of metres high
en.dek: An underground water pipe ruptured at a roadside works site on Guo Rui Road near Summit Terrace around 11am, producing a water column estimated at about ten storeys high; the Water Supplies Department is carrying out…
body: A water main burst at a roadside construction site on Guo Rui Road near Summit Terrace in Tsuen Wan shortly after 11am on Friday. Water shot tens of metres into the air, reaching roughly the height of a ten-storey building, with spray drifting onto the adjacent carriageway.

District councillors and Care Team members attended the scene. The Water Supplies Department sent staff to shut off the supply and begin emergency repairs. Local media reported the water column remained visible around midday.

The incident caused temporary disruption in the immediate area. No injuries were reported in initial accounts. Residents and motorists were advised to exercise caution near the works site while repairs continue.

zh.headline: 荃灣國瑞路工地爆水管 水柱高約十層樓
zh.dek: 周五上午11時許，荃灣國瑞路近昇柏山對開路邊工地有地底水管爆裂，水柱噴高約十層樓，水務署已到場關掣搶修。
body: 周五上午11時許，荃灣國瑞路近昇柏山對開一路邊工地發生地底水管爆裂，水柱噴射至約十層樓高度，水花飄散至毗鄰行車線。
荃灣區議員及關愛隊人員到場了解。水務署已派員關閉水掣並進行緊急搶修。中午時分現場仍可見水柱持續噴出。
事件對附近一帶造成短暫影響，初步未有人受傷。市民及司機經過有關工地時應提高警覺，留意搶修進度。
